description: Extract every file and directory path from a document, with its kind and 1-based line and column. Reads JSON, YAML, TOML, CSV, dotenv, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS with a parser for that format, and anything else — Python, Go, Markdown, a Dockerfile — by scanning its text, which finds paths that carry a separator or a quoted filename. Each path is classified as file, relative, absolute or url. Paths are reported as written — nothing is resolved against a workspace or the filesystem.

dedupe.description: Collapse repeated paths to their first occurrence.

filename.description: Filename used to infer the format when `format` is absent, e.g. "tsconfig.json".

format.description: Document format. Common extensions and aliases are accepted. Omit it and `filename` to scan the text generically.

maxResults.description: Cap on returned paths (default 500). meta.truncated reports whether any were dropped.

name: extract_paths
